propositions: The multi-project model shipped without documentation of its behaviour in jira-sync-setup.md, config.md, and migrations.md, presenting project as a single scalar and omitting sections on multiple projects and the new ensure units.

Two architectural decisions—store-level project ownership and event-free legacy migration—are load-bearing, non-obvious, and expensive to reverse, requiring an ADR to record their rationale and rejected alternatives.
Operators upgrading client stores need documented guidance on what the new required_capabilities entry means for older binaries in mixed-version fleets and how to remediate the fail-closed behaviour.

Documentation must describe the project mapping, the bridge projects verb, the tri-state project field, the repos field, and both new ensure units without presenting single-project constraints as current behaviour.
